content: HM table-stakes modules on non-NixOS hosts (NixOS wiki Home Manager page + home-manager option docs + programs/bash.nix + programs/tmux.nix module sources): targets.genericLinux.enable=true is the non-negotiable env fixer (XDG_DATA_DIRS etc). programs.bash.enable=true manages .bashrc/.profile and sources hm-session-vars.sh (wiki: the most convenient way to make profiles work; migration path = bashrcExtra sourcing old .bashrc); bash module options include enableCompletion, historySize/historyFile, shellAliases, initExtra/bashrcExtra/profileExtra, sessionVariables. programs.git.enable+settings generates ~/.config/git/config. programs.tmux.enable with extraConfig, plugins (tmuxPlugins.sensible/resurrect/continuum), secureSocket, prefix. programs.fzf.enable=files. xdg.configFile.'...'.source/.text manages configs without dedicated modules; home.file for dotfiles. fonts.fontconfig.enable for system fonts; home.sessionVariables for EDITOR etc. Anti-feature-ish: full DE theming (stylix) and complex program modules (programs.neovim-level) not needed when vim is packaged via vim-full.customize.
